title: Thunderbird not responding, reinstall/safe mode not helping
creator: amy20
content:
After a reboot and Windows 11 update today, Thunderbird (I believe it was v155) will not open. It asks for the password, then sits at [Not Responding].

I have copied my profiles (there are two, one dated 2023 with only a 1K .json file in it, and one created tonight while I was troubleshooting that's several GB and when copying, appears to contain all my mail folders although I can't access them directly from within the profile) to a separate location (my desktop).

I've tried the following (after checking previous questions here in Mozilla support):

(1) booting Windows into safe mode

(2) opening Thunderbird in Troubleshooting mode (Shift while opening), both in Windows safe mode and normal boot

(3) uninstalled Thunderbird from Control Panel, downloaded and installed a new copy of Thunderbird

All give the same result: "not responding", can't click anything. Can only wait or close.

I was able to disable an extension that I installed yesterday that had been working fine.

I'm also wondering if the problem is mail folders that are too large. I have some candidates for deletion but since I can't see any .msf files for them, I can't delete (because I can't open Thunderbird.

I'm leery of instructions to outright delete any Thunderbird folders/files because (1) I can't see my mail folders directly and (2) I'm self-employed and all my client and business emails are in there. Losing them woud be a disaster.

I'm tempted to try the Windows option of restoring my entire computer to an earlier point, say, this morning. But that seems like possible overkill if it's an issue with just Thunderbird.

I'm freaking out, please help!

title: Thunderbird Windows 11
creator: blackserver78
content:
I’m asking for an update: regarding the total message count, folders with no messages now show a dash, which is really confusing. Could this be fixed so that a dash doesn't appear when there are 0 messages? Before the update, it wasn't like that—it used to show the message count, and there was no dash when there were no messages.

I have been asking for this for at least 20 versions now: the backup and restore function—which is supposed to work when setting up a fresh Windows 11 installation, for example—fails to carry over certain settings. Specifically, things like the "Participants," "Date," and "Name" columns, the sort arrows (up/down), and other menu column settings aren't restored correctly. View settings—such as grouping vs. non-grouping or hidden columns—are also lost; after restoring, you have to manually set up all the columns and date ordering again yourself.

Problem 3

When I type a name into the address book and it appears, I have to click next to the name. However, if I click straight into the text field to start writing and then try to send something, a different contact from the address book might appear instead. This is a bug. For example, I typed in "Mom," but instead of clicking next to the name, I clicked into the text field, and my boss ended up receiving the email—it was embarrassing. Could there be a setting so that when an address book name appears and you jump straight to the text field, that name stays selected instead of switching to a different address book entry?

title: non è possibile connettersi al server, la connessione è stata rifiutata
creator: agazzi.ezio
content: Buongiorno. Da qualche mese riscontro dei problemi durante lo scaricamento della posta. Premetto che uso Thunderbird per 6 account di posta. Uno di questi è gmail, un altro è un account pec mentre gli altri 4 account sono classici pop3 sullo stesso provider. di questi 4 account il problema si presenta frequentemente solo sui due info@ mentre gli altri due non hanno mai presentato il disguido. xxxx@gmail.com - xxxx@pec.it - info@xxxxx.it - fornitori@xxxx.it - contabilita@xxxx.it - info@----.it In pratica, all'avvio di thunderbird il programma scarica la posta normalmente, come del resto ha sempre fatto, tranne che in frequenti occasioni dai due account info@. Si legge nella finestra di dialogo: non è possibile connettersi al server, la connessione è stata rifiutata. Però se clicco sulla nuvoletta in alto a sinistra a volte scarica la posta a volte risponde con la stessa finestra di dialogo. Ho provato a chiudere il programma e riaprirlo senza risultati ma a volte dopo la chiusura e la riapertura il programma si comporta normalmente scaricando dai due account che solo un attimo prima davano problemi. Non credo sia un problema di impostazioni o di firewall perchè il problema si presenta molto frequentemente ma non sempre. Grazie per l'aiuto
